LAW AND MOTION 301, AFTER THE ARGUMENT, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS JOHN K. LEE, ELIZABETH TSAI, EDDY SHUM, YUI HEI CHAN'S MOTION TO STRIKE COMPLAINT IS DENIED. THE GRAVAMEN OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIMS IS NOT DEFENDANT'S PROTECTED ACTIVITY BUT DEFENDANT'S ALLEGED FAILURE TO MAKE REQUIRED CAPITAL CONTRIBUTIONS. ANY RELEVANCE OF THE PRIOR ACTION IS THAT PLAINTIFF'S OWN CLAIMS IN THAT ACTION ALLEGEDLY GIVE IT STANDING TO BRING THIS ACTION. PLAINTIFF DOES NOT SEEK TO IMPOSE ANY LIABILITY ON DEFENDANT FOR HAVING BROUGHT OR DEFENDED THE PRIOR ACTION. REQUESTS FOR SANCTIONS DENIED. ORDER WAS SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J.
